name: Gide FreeCell
headline: Classic FreeCell, easy on the eyes.
lede: Big, clear cards you tap to move, hints that always lead toward a win, and the classic numbered games. No ads, timers, or accounts.

features.title: Big, clear cards
features.body: High-contrast cards in a typeface made for easy reading, sized to fill your phone or tablet.

features.title: Tap to move
features.body: Tap a card and it goes to the best spot. Press and hold to put it in a free cell. No dragging.

features.title: Hints that lead to a win
features.body: Tap Hint and the game works out a move that still wins. If you can no longer win from where you are, it tells you, so you can Undo.

features.title: The classic numbered games
features.body: Play any game from #1 to #32000, the same deals as the FreeCell you remember. The one deal that can't be won is never dealt.

features.title: Four-color suits
features.body: Turn on blue diamonds and green clubs to tell the suits apart at a glance.

features.title: Less tapping
features.body: Cards the table no longer needs go home on their own, and the game finishes itself once every column is in order.

privacy.heading: Nothing to collect.
privacy.body: Gide FreeCell works without an account or an internet connection. Your game and settings are saved only on your device.

points.title: No ads
points.body: No pop-ups, banners, or videos between games.

points.title: No tracking
points.body: The app doesn't collect, share, or sell any information.

points.title: Works offline
points.body: Play anywhere, with or without a connection.

faq.a: All but one of the 32,000 classic games can be won, and that one (#11982) is never dealt. You can still get stuck by your own moves. Hint tells you when that has happened, and Undo lets you back up and try another way.

faq.q: Are these the same game numbers I remember?
faq.a: Yes. Gide FreeCell uses the same numbered deals as the classic FreeCell, so Game #617 is the same layout it has always been. Choose New game, then Play a game by number.
No. There's no sign-in, and nothing leaves your device.

faq.q: Can I make the suits easier to tell apart?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on Four-color suits in Settings for blue diamonds and green clubs.
Yes. The cards grow to fill the screen, in portrait or landscape.

cta.heading: Deal a calm game.
cta.body: Gide FreeCell is classic FreeCell with big cards, hints that lead to a win, and no ads.
